prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE reusable placeholder illustration for an achievement in the Russian educational app Запоминальня. A small stack of three blank flashcards with one card upright, a simple five-point star drawn on the upright card, and a modest fabric bookmark ribbon. A calm thoughtful blue ballpoint-pen and fine engraved cross-hatching illustration, matching blue-ink sketches on a paper study notebook. Main ink dark navy #233D89 with some lighter blue lines and very subtle cream highlights on the cards. Clear recognizable silhouette, refined hand-drawn shading and perspective, not a flat icon, not a shiny 3D render. Object centered in a square canvas with generous transparent padding on every side, entire subject visible, no crop. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND; no white rectangle, no backdrop, no surrounding ground or paper texture outside the object, no cast shadow outside the illustration, no text, no numbers, no logo, no border, no trophy or laurel wreath, no confetti. This same image will be used on every achievement card, so keep its subject universal rather than specific to a metric. This is the complete requested asset, only one illustration.
